source.title: Feliks Zemdegs wins World Rubik's Cube Championship 2013
source.content:
[Feliks Zemdegs](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009ZEMD01) won the [World Rubik's Cube Championship 2013](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=WC2013) with an average of 8.18 seconds. [Mats Valk](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2007VALK01) finished second (8.65) and [Sebastian Weyer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2010WEYE02) finished third (8.86).  
 World records: Evan Liu Rubik's Clock 6.79 (average), Kevin Hays 7x7 Cube 2:54.77 (average), Marcell Endrey 5x5 blindfolded 6:06.41 (single).  
 Oceanian records: Feliks Zemdegs 4x4 Cube 30.49 (average), 3x3 one-handed 10.12 (single), 3x3 fewest moves 31 (single), Megaminx 55.67 (average) 52.97 (single), 6x6 Cube 1:54.43 (single), 7x7 Cube 3:00.35 (average) 2:55.44 (single), Jayden McNeill 3x3 fewest moves 31 (single), Zane Carney 5x5 blindfolded 8:26.37 (single).  
 European records: Bence Barát 7x7 Cube 2:59.40 (average) 2:48.55 (single), Jakub Kipa 3x3 with feet 38.22 (average).  
 North American records: Drew Brads Pyraminx 3.16 (average), Evan Liu Rubik's Clock 5.45 (single), Gabriel Alejandro Orozco Casillas 3x3 blindfolded 25.32 (single), Kevin Hays 5x5 Cube 59.06 (average) 51.85 (single), 7x7 Cube 3:02.31 (average) 2:42.80 (single), Louis Cormier 3x3 with feet 39.00 (single), Megaminx 52.45 (average) 46.90 (single), Rowe Hessler 4x4 Cube 29.30 (single), Tim Wong 3x3 multi blind 20/23 57:51 (single).

translation.title: Feliks Zemdegs 获得 2013 年世界魔方锦标赛冠军
translation.content:
[Feliks Zemdegs](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2009ZEMD01) 以 8.18 秒的平均成绩获得 [2013 年世界魔方锦标赛](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/c.php?i=WC2013)冠军。[Mats Valk](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2007VALK01) 以 8.65 秒获得亚军，[Sebastian Weyer](https://www.worldcubeassociation.org/results/p.php?i=2010WEYE02) 以 8.86 秒获得季军。

世界纪录：Evan Liu，魔表平均 6.79 秒；Kevin Hays，七阶平均 2:54.77；Marcell Endrey，五阶盲拧单次 6:06.41。

大洋洲纪录：Feliks Zemdegs，四阶平均 30.49 秒、三阶单手单次 10.12 秒、三阶最少步单次 31 步、五魔方平均 55.67 秒、单次 52.97 秒、六阶单次 1:54.43、七阶平均 3:00.35、单次 2:55.44；Jayden McNeill，三阶最少步单次 31 步；Zane Carney，五阶盲拧单次 8:26.37。

欧洲纪录：Bence Barát，七阶平均 2:59.40、单次 2:48.55；Jakub Kipa，三阶脚拧平均 38.22 秒。

北美洲纪录：Drew Brads，金字塔平均 3.16 秒；Evan Liu，魔表单次 5.45 秒；Gabriel Alejandro Orozco Casillas，三阶盲拧单次 25.32 秒；Kevin Hays，五阶平均 59.06 秒、单次 51.85 秒，七阶平均 3:02.31、单次 2:42.80；Louis Cormier，三阶脚拧单次 39.00 秒，五魔方平均 52.45 秒、单次 46.90 秒；Rowe Hessler，四阶单次 29.30 秒；Tim Wong，三阶多盲单次 20/23，用时 57:51。
